address: 四川省成都市武侯区浆洗街街道锦里结义楼锦里古街
intro: 锦里，又名锦里一条街、锦里古街，是位於中國四川省成都市的一條古商業街，最早可追溯到秦漢時期。传说中锦里曾是西蜀历史上最古老、最具有商业气息的街道之一，早在秦汉、三国时期便闻名全国。锦里毗邻武侯祠，頗有古蜀國民風。現在的锦里已經被開發成一條民俗商業步行街，混合三國文化以及川西文化。
intro_en: Jinli, also known as Jinli Street or Jinli Ancient Street, is an ancient commercial street located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, China, with a history dating back to the Qin and Han dynasties. Legend has it that Jinli was once one of the oldest and most commercially vibrant streets in the history of Western Shu, renowned nationwide as early as the Qin, Han, and Three Kingdoms periods. Adjacent to the Wuhou Shrine, Jinli retains much of the folk customs of the ancient Shu Kingdom. Today, Jinli has been developed into a folk-culture commercial pedestrian street, blending Three Kingdoms culture with Western Sichuan culture.
address_en:
Location: Jinli Ancient Street
Jinli Jieyi Building, Jinli Ancient Street, Jiangxijie Subdistrict, Wuhou District, Chengdu, Sichuan Province

Location: Guanqian Street
Extending west from the main thoroughfare Renmin Road (formerly Hulong Street) to Cufang Bridge in the east, where it meets Lindun Road, the street has the thousand-year-old Taoist temple Xuanmiao Temple—facing south with its back to the north—at its center, directly facing Gong Alley. intro_en: Qianmen Street is a street in Dongcheng District, Beijing, located on Beijing's Central Axis. Qianmen Street is a traditional commercial street in Beijing, adjacent to Tiananmen Square. Qianmen Street and the surrounding Dashilar and Qianmen subdistricts are home to many time-honored Chinese brands, such as Tongrentang, Quanjude, and Zhangyiyuan.
